text:
aj: Quick q — we need a clear policy for when a tenant with Dedicated capacity overflows. current ask: should we spill to hosted or fail? platinum customers are pushing for no-fallback guarantees.
cheng: short answer: we currently have a spillover path but it's opt-in per contract. most infra uses 'allow_spillover: true' by default for non-enterprise.
maria: enterprise contracts usually require isolation. legal will push back if we silently route their traffic to hosted. also billing: we need to tag cost to tenant and show delta.
aj: can we do a hybrid? try dedicated, if saturated, fallback to a compatible model variant in hosted but only if tenant explicitly allowed.
cheng: agreed. implement a per-tenant flag: `spill_policy: [deny|allow_variant_only|allow_full]`. default = allow_variant_only for SaaS tiers, deny for enterprise.
opsbot: deploy triggered: rollout/routing-guard v1 -> canary 3 hosts (eng-platform).
maria: variant-only still worries me — data plane might leave the private/vpc boundary if model lives in hosted. need a SLA note in console and an audit log entry.
lina: from billing perspective we must surface `spill_cost` separately in invoice itemization. also need telemetry to show when model variant was used vs original.
cheng: telemetry plan: add `route_reason` tag (dedicated_ok, capacity_spill, policy_denied), `orig_model`, `served_model`, `tier`, `region`. send to per-tenant trace and overall metric.
aj: console UX: expose a toggle and a short explainer tooltip. default should show current effective policy and last 7 days spill events.
devx-bot: note: ux mockups in Figma -> https://figma.com/redwood/rollouts/fallback-ux (wip).
maria: also require an explicit legal checkbox for `allow_full` for enterprise during contract onboarding.
cheng: implementation sketch (pseudocode):
```
route_request(req):
  if tenant.spill_policy == 'deny':
    try_dedicated_or_fail(req)
  else:
    if dedicated_has_capacity(req):
      route_to_dedicated(req)
    else:
      if tenant.spill_policy == 'allow_variant_only':
        variant = find_compatible_variant(req.model, tenant.region)
        if variant: route_to_hosted(variant)
        else: fail_with_no_capacity()
      else: # allow_full
        route_to_hosted(req.model)
```

maria: +1 but make sure `find_compatible_variant` doesn't pick lower-quality without notice. add `quality_delta` field and surface to tenant.
cheng: we'll add `quality_estimate` and require `max_quality_drop` per tenant (default 0.05).
lina: metrics to collect for alerts: `spillover_count`, `spill_mean_latency_delta_ms`, `spill_cost_delta_usd`, `spill_ratio_by_tier`. set team alerts if spill_ratio_by_tier > 0.02 for enterprise.
aj: ops question — routing telemetry needs minimal overhead. prefer sampling at 1% for detailed traces, aggregate counters always emitted.
cheng: agree. trace sampling 1% + aggregated counters per minute. also log an event for every enterprise spill.
opsbot: incident note: last night 2026-03-12T02:17Z — tenant T-753 hit dedicated OOM, 42 requests spilled to hosted, no SLA breach reported.
maria: followup: schedule a short legal + sales sync to update contract language and UI copy.
aj: next steps: cheng to PR policy schema + runtime guard, devx to add console toggle + tooltip, lina to spec billing lineitems, maria to coordinate legal approval. target: canary next week. :thumbsup:
cheng: I'll open the PR today, tag @aj @maria.
aj: thanks — keep thread updates small, please.
